title: Add up one row
hints: Row `r` is `cols` boxes long. Its boxes are at `r * cols + 0`, `r * cols + 1`, and so on up to column `cols - 1`.
Count `c` from 0 up to `cols - 1`. On each turn, read the box at `r * cols + c` and add it to a running total that starts at 0.
Start with `total = 0`. Inside `for c in range(cols):` do `total = total + grid[r * cols + c]`. Return `total` after the loop.
explain: The reference counts `c` from 0 to `cols - 1`, reads the box at `r * cols + c` each time and adds it to a total. A loop over a grid is a loop over flat positions. Week 3 writes this same loop in `.uir`, with `r * cols + c` as the offset of a view.
